import cadquery as cq

# PARAMETERS
total_h = 100.0      # mm - total height
belly_r = 30.0       # mm - belly radius (60mm diameter)
base_r = 20.0        # mm - base radius
rim_r = 15.0         # mm - rim/neck radius
neck_h = 15.0        # mm - height of neck section
belly_h = 55.0       # mm - height at which belly is widest
wall_t = 2.0         # mm - wall thickness

# Build the outer profile in XZ plane, then revolve
# Profile points from bottom to top
outer = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(base_r, 0)
    .lineTo(base_r, 2)                              # slight base edge
    .spline([(28, 20), (30, belly_h), (20, 85), (rim_r, 100)], includeCurrent=True)
    .lineTo(rim_r, total_h)                          # top edge
    .lineTo(0, total_h)
    .lineTo(0, 0)
    .close()
    .revolve(360, (0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0))
)

# Inner profile for hollowing - offset inward
inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(base_r - wall_t, wall_t)
    .lineTo(base_r - wall_t, 2 + wall_t)
    .spline([(28 - wall_t, 20 + wall_t), (30 - wall_t, belly_h), (20 - wall_t, 85), (rim_r - wall_t, total_h - wall_t)], includeCurrent=True)
    .lineTo(rim_r - wall_t, total_h)
    .lineTo(0, total_h)
    .lineTo(0, wall_t)
    .close()
    .revolve(360, (0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0))
)

result = outer.cut(inner)

import cadquery as cq

# PARAMETERS
total_h = 100.0      # mm - total height
belly_r = 30.0       # mm - belly radius (60mm diameter)
base_r = 20.0        # mm - base radius
rim_r = 14.0         # mm - rim/neck radius
neck_h = 15.0        # mm - height of neck section
belly_h = 55.0       # mm - height at which belly is widest
wall_t = 2.0         # mm - wall thickness
foot_h = 3.0         # mm - base foot height

# Outer profile using threePointArc for smooth curve
# Points: base -> belly -> neck -> rim
outer = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(base_r, 0)
    .lineTo(base_r, foot_h)                                                   # foot
    .threePointArc((belly_r, belly_h), (rim_r, total_h - neck_h))             # belly curve
    .lineTo(rim_r, total_h)                                                   # rim top
    .lineTo(0, total_h)                                                       # center axis at top
    .lineTo(0, 0)                                                             # center axis at bottom
    .close()
    .revolve(360, (0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0))
)

# Inner profile - offset inward by wall thickness
inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(base_r - wall_t, wall_t)
    .lineTo(base_r - wall_t, foot_h)
    .threePointArc((belly_r - wall_t, belly_h), (rim_r - wall_t, total_h - neck_h))
    .lineTo(rim_r - wall_t, total_h - wall_t)
    .lineTo(0, total_h - wall_t)
    .lineTo(0, wall_t)
    .close()
    .revolve(360, (0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0))
)

result = outer.cut(inner)
